labels.label: Version 1
labels.description: Serialized transaction version 1.

labels.label: Version 2
labels.description: Serialized transaction version 2.

labels.label: Version 3
labels.description: Serialized transaction version 3.

labels.label: Other version
labels.description: A transaction version other than 1, 2, or 3.

labels.label: Signals RBF
labels.description: At least one input explicitly signals BIP-125 replaceability.

labels.label: Has witness
labels.description: At least one input has witness data.

labels.label: Taproot annex
labels.description: A P2TR input has a structural annex candidate.

labels.label: P2PK
labels.description: A known input or output uses pay-to-public-key.

labels.label: Bare multisig
labels.description: A known input or output uses bare multisig.

labels.label: P2PKH
labels.description: A known input or output uses pay-to-public-key-hash.

labels.label: P2SH
labels.description: A known input or output uses pay-to-script-hash.

labels.label: P2WPKH
labels.description: A known input or output uses native witness public-key-hash.

labels.label: P2WSH
labels.description: A known input or output uses native witness script-hash.

labels.label: P2TR
labels.description: A known input or output uses Taproot.

labels.label: P2A
labels.description: A known input or output uses pay-to-anchor.

labels.label: Other witness program
labels.description: A known input or output uses another syntactically valid witness program.

labels.label: OP_RETURN
labels.description: An output uses OP_RETURN.

labels.label: Other script
labels.description: A known input or output script is outside the recognized families.

labels.label: Possible CoinJoin
labels.description: A conservative equal-output, no-script-reuse heuristic.

labels.label: Consolidation
labels.description: At least five times as many inputs as outputs.

labels.label: Batch payout
labels.description: At least five times as many outputs as inputs.

labels.label: Other shape
labels.description: Every registered transaction-shape heuristic was terminal and none matched.

labels.label: Inscription
labels.description: An Ordinals inscription-envelope fingerprint.

labels.label: BRC-20
labels.description: A JSON-like BRC-20 marker inside an inscription envelope.

labels.label: Runes
labels.description: An OP_RETURN OP_13 runestone marker.

labels.label: Stamps
labels.description: A bare-multisig carrier whose deobfuscated payload holds a Stamps marker.

labels.label: Counterparty
labels.description: A deobfuscated CNTRPRTY envelope in an OP_RETURN or bare-multisig carrier.

labels.label: Omni
labels.description: An OP_RETURN payload beginning with the Omni Class C marker.

labels.label: Other OP_RETURN
labels.description: An OP_RETURN carrier with no registered OP_RETURN protocol fingerprint.

labels.label: No detected protocol
labels.description: No registered data-protocol fingerprint fired.

labels.label: Push/drop witness carrier
labels.description: A revealed witness script contains a large balanced data-push and drop run.

labels.label: Opcode-value coding
labels.description: A revealed witness script contains a valid self-framed OP_PLENTY opcode sequence.

labels.label: Output-field carrier
labels.description: A self-consistent OLGA-style payload spans an exact equal-value P2WSH output run.

labels.label: Off-curve P2TR key
labels.description: A P2TR output contains bytes that are not a valid secp256k1 x-only public key.

labels.label: No detected carriage shape
labels.description: No registered data-carriage shape heuristic fired.

labels.label: Compatible
labels.description: No BIP-110 policy violation or missing fact was found.

labels.label: Would violate
labels.description: At least one BIP-110 policy violation was proven.

labels.label: Indeterminate
labels.description: No violation was proven and at least one required fact is missing.
